thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx + timeout spike for /v1/generate across gateway clusters us-west-2 and eu-central-1. Error rate > 7% over 60s. Paging SRE oncall. Logs: https://logs.internal/redwood/alerts/4298765432

maya-cheng: I'm seeing scheduler queue length climb rapidly, head-of-line blocking on batcher-01. KV cache growth + small model cold starts. QLen per shard: 1200, 1300, 900.

kevin-li: Oncall here (kev-li). Acknowledging page. Starting triage. Any customer-facing errors reported?

lena-garcia: Support reported multiple customer timeouts from XenoCorp and Beacon AI. They see 524 + gateway timeouts. CS is preparing template.

maya-cheng: quick snapshot from runtime: ```
[2026-03-15T14:10:21Z] batcher-01 queue=1287 inflight=425 kv_cache_mb=12340 pending_evictions=0
[2026-03-15T14:10:22Z] gateway-usw-2 5xx=342 504=78 latency_p50=180ms p95=2.4s
[2026-03-15T14:10:23Z] scheduler: requeue_rate=0.9 backlog_ms=12000
```

alex-park: Looks like continuous batching + long-running requests are creating a head-of-line stall. We should reduce batch window and enable preemptive eviction.

sre-oncall: Taking lead. Actions: 1) Disable batching on the gateway for high-latency route '/v1/generate' as emergency fallback. 2) Expand batcher pool capacity + spawn emergency nodes. 3) Route heavy customers to dedicated instances.

kevin-li: Doing step 1 now. Command: `/infra reroute --route /v1/generate --disable-batching`

deploy-bot: executed: `/infra reroute --route /v1/generate --disable-batching` -> success. 200 routes updated.

kevin-li: Step 2 - scaling batcher pool. Command: `/scale pool=batchers-std count=18`

deploy-bot: scaling initiated: pool=batchers-std desired=18 current=6. Expected warm-up 90s.

maya-cheng: While pool is adding nodes, apply short-term throttling: set per-customer concurrency caps and reduce max sequence length to 512 on the gateway.

alex-park: Applying concurrency caps for xeno and beacon. Also enabling prefix KV caching for frequent prompts.

support-bot: CS alerts queued: 2 customers identified (XenoCorp, Beacon AI). Template draft: "We're investigating elevated timeouts; engineering working on mitigation. Will update in 15 min."

lena-garcia: Sending initial customer messages now. Notifying enterprise accounts and opening Zoom with XenoCorp (they requested live updates).

[14:12:30Z] deploy-bot: pool=batchers-std reached 14 nodes; batcher service started on 8 new nodes. Queue length dropping but still elevated: global_qlen=730.

maya-cheng: Observed improvement in KV eviction after adding nodes but still some stuck requests causing 5xx. Running a targeted eviction script on affected shards.

kevin-li: Running eviction: `/runtime evict --shard batcher-01 --threshold 80%`

deploy-bot: eviction job queued -> completed in 12s. freed 4.2GB KV per node.

[14:16:05Z] alex-park: Gateway 5xx rate down to 2.1%. P95 latency 560ms. Some customers still seeing timeouts when routing through legacy gateway. I'll fallback route legacy->dedicated for Beacon.

kevin-li: Routing change done for Beacon. `/route set --customer beacon-ai --target dedicated-beacon-1` -> success.

cs-lead-zoe: Updated statuspage: "Partial degradation: Some customers may experience increased errors and timeouts on text generation endpoints. Engineers are mitigating. Next update in 15 minutes."

support-bot: Incident created in PagerDuty: PD-INC-7281. Slack thread pinned to channel.

maya-cheng: Root cause preliminary: scheduler batching policy + unexpectedly long tail requests (3rd-party connector calls) caused continual batch hold. Head-of-line blocking prevented younger requests from being processed, inflating response latency and causing gateway timeouts.

kevin-li: Current mitigation summary: batching disabled for hotspot route, scaled batcher pool to 18 (still ramping), evicted heavy KV entries, routed high-impact customers to dedicated instances, applied per-customer concurrency caps. 5xx rate reduced from 7% -> 1.5%.

lena-garcia: CS: XenoCorp on a call. They require an RCA with ETA for fix. We told them we'll follow up within 24 hours.

alex-park: Short-term follow-ups: 1) revert batching disable only after validating queue depth and p95 < 300ms for 10m. 2) add a fast-path preemptive eviction in scheduler to avoid HOL blocking. 3) add per-route safety throttle to prevent single tenant from saturating the batcher.

sre-oncall: Creating an incident ticket and postmortem board. Jira: RED-INC-9123. Assigning root-cause to eng-runtime and eng-sre.

incident-bot: Incident severity set to sev2. Notifying oncall escalation list.

[14:28:12Z] deploy-bot: pool=batchers-std reached desired=18. Observed global_qlen=210.

kevin-li: Confirming p95s: US-West p95 210ms, EU p95 260ms. Will start re-enabling batching with smaller window: window_ms=20, max_batch=16 for 10m canary.

maya-cheng: Canary started. Watch for queue oscillation. If qlen > 400 -> rollback to batching disabled.

[14:34:55Z] incident-bot: Monitoring note: error-rate trending downward. Severity retained until stable for 30m.

cs-lead-zoe: Customers notified: XenoCorp acknowledged mitigation and accepted dedicated routing. Beacon AI on boarding to dedicated queue. No data exposure.

support-bot: Post-incident actions created in ticket RED-INC-9123: ["add HOL detection metric","scheduler preemptive-evict feature","per-route batching thresholds","improve statuspage automation"].

kevin-li: I'm handing off to maya for post-incident and PM follow-ups. I'll remain reachable for emergency. :thumbsup:

maya-cheng: Taking handoff. Will draft timeline + postmortem. Tentative RCA: batching policy + long-tail connectors + lack of per-route throttles.

alex-park: Notes for postmortem: include examples of problematic prompts, list of affected shards, timeline of commands, and a runbook update (add 'disable-batching' quickbutton).

lena-garcia: Will collate customer comms. CS to follow up with XenoCorp and Beacon in 24h.

[14:46:00Z] incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Next update in 30 minutes.

kevin-li: Closing active paging. Handed off fully to maya. Good job everyone.

maya-cheng: Thanks all. Postmortem ETA EOD tomorrow. Assigning action owners in RED-INC-9123.

support-bot: Reaction summary: :thumbsup: x14, :heart: x3.
